channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Saddiq Bey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Saddiq Bey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
James Edwards III:Troy Weaver on Saddiq Bey:

“Saddiq is like family to me. He's a worker, tremendous young man. He brought a lot to the table, and he'll continue in his young career to grow as a player. I'm excited for him. I'm praying for his success.”

Troy Weaver on Saddiq Bey, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Jerry Stackhouse on Isaiah Stewart, Saddiq Bey
item.description:
“He can make plays for others, can make plays for himself. This kid, he kind of reminds me of myself, the way that he attacks the basket. I don't know if I had any point-guard skills (laughs). I'm excited for Saddiq Bey and Stewart. Those guys bring a toughness that really represents Detroit and what we're about. I think it's time for them to take that next step.”

Jerry Stackhouse on Isaiah Stewart, Saddiq Bey, Jul 26, 2022. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
#Pistons Isaiah Stewart on Saddiq Bey trying to get others involved when he got going:

“That's good karma, when you know you can get the shot and you're still trying to get everybody involved.”

Isaiah Stewart on Saddiq Bey, Mar 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on Saddiq Bey:

“He is a great shooter and shooters go through (slumps). He's not surprising teams and their game plans are very aware of him and his game. He's going to Plan B, which he should do.”

Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Oct 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey:

“I told him (before the season) that I didn't know if his game would translate to the NBA game -- and it did... I think he's a consistent NBA starter.”

Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, May 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on college scouting of Saddiq Bey:

“We didn't think he was going to be there... I hadn't studies him as much... The next step is putting the ball on the court and taking it to the rim.”

Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Blake Griffin
item.description:
#PistonsDwane Casey on ripple effect of Blake Griffin being out:

“We're going to look at a lot of different situations and lineups. It should be increased minutes for Svi, Sekou and Saddiq.”

Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Blake Griffin, Feb 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey's slump after a hot start:

“Nothing to be alarmed about. The young man is working his behind off... there's always going to be a leveling off period and that's what he's going through right now. He'll bounce back.”

Dwane Casey on Saddiq Bey, Jan 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Luol Deng, Derrick Rose, Saddiq Bey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Saddiq:

“I see him as a Luol Deng-type, that's who Derrick told me he reminded me of.”

Dwane Casey on Luol Deng, Derrick Rose, Saddiq Bey, Jan 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Saddiq Bey, Russell Westbrook, Bradley Beal
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on potential matchups with #Wizards Beal and Westbrook for young players:

“It'll give a good feel for what Killian, Saben and Saddiq have to look forward to. It's a good test for us.”

Dwane Casey on Killian Hayes, Saddiq Bey, Russell Westbrook, Bradley Beal, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Saddiq Bey
item.description:
Griffin:

“Saddiq has one of the most complete games I’ve seen from a rookie. One of my favorite things about him is his hunger for getting better and for the game of basketball.”

Blake Griffin on Saddiq Bey, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.
